isolated_candidates.candidate_description: Vector pair-plan v6 with float sign/threshold predicates after bounded INT32 arithmetic; retain exact Native addresses, validated separately in six-tensor planner unit
isolated_candidates.postload_fix: Re-export unchanged QR_OK/KV_OK metadata expected by prepare_csa_model; all existing math/source bytes unchanged.

actual_control.implemented_by: same H3 function AST as formal package, separate namespace csa_gap_h3
actual_control.note: historical baseline fields describe inherited lineage; actual comparison control is current H3.

isolated_candidates.v2_fix: Explicit INT32 casts for Tile scalar operands; no algorithm change.
isolated_candidates.v3_fix: All checked output uses one MTE3 store path; fallback scalar writes only UB Tile then stores it. No GM scalar/MTE3 mixture.
isolated_candidates.v4_fix: Page-bound reduction uses eight aligned rows, unchanged exact predicate; no SDK edit.
isolated_candidates.v5_fix: A3 INT32 AND-scalar unavailable: exact nonnegative remainder via subtraction and shifts, matching nalinaly physical-plan idiom.

test_order: performance persisted first; then Native precision if combined wins or explicit boundary regression

performance.criterion: combined >=0.5% lower event median vs current formal combined, >=10/12 wins each, L1 lower; independent reverse repeat
